newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Miffed EU invites Arafat to meet ministers.
newsitem.headline: Miffed EU invites Arafat to meet ministers.

text.p: The European Union, angered by its exclusion from a special U.S. summit on the Middle East, has invited Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat to a meeting of its foreign ministers in Luxembourg, officials said on Monday.

PLO officials in Jerusalem confirmed that Arafat would meet EU ministers in Luxembourg on Monday night to discuss the near-collapse of the Middle East peace process, which receives strong financial support form the EU.

The EU invitation was made for Tuesday and the ministerial meeting begins on Tuesday, but several ministers were arriving in Luxembourg on Monday, including the current Irish presidency which issued the invitation.
Some EU states have been angered at their exclusion from a summit meeting called by U.S. President Bill Clinton for Tuesday to try and save the Israeli-Palestinian peace accords.

Aarafat has asked Clinton to delay the proposed summit in Washington with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu but Israeli officials said Netanyahu was preparing to leave for the United States as planned.
